services.desc: “My husband, Dave, brings his work team from VA out for a day in Annapolis every summer. This June, we took them out on the Schooner Woodwind. Everyone had a blast! Thanks for the great Annapolis experience!” “One of our best summer outings yet! Staff had a wonderful time! Excellent comments from all attendees. Thanks for a wonderful day on the water!” Experience sailing the Chesapeake Bay on an authentic 74-foot schooner! Private cruises aboard the Schooner Woodwind offer your group exclusive use of one or both schooners and can accommodate up to 40 guests aboard each vessel.
